implementation_order_status.meaning: The parent lifecycle implementation order is exhausted. This does not establish total Book product completion, production readiness, real author evidence, Document System implementation or publication authority.

current_parent_critical_path.objective: Resume and complete the Book-only product census against current Book contracts, executable/qualified evidence, System Master expectation inventory, child/delegated ownership boundaries and human/publication/Document dependencies. Classify each expected Book capability as QUALIFIED_EXECUTABLE, IMPLEMENTED_UNQUALIFIED, CONTRACT_OR_RESEARCH_ONLY, DELEGATED_TO_OTHER_OWNER, CHILD_PROSE_DEPENDENCY, HUMAN_OR_AUTHOR_BLOCKED, EXTERNAL_OR_NATIVE_BLOCKED, NOT_REQUIRED or GAP_REQUIRING_NEW_OBJECTIVE.
current_parent_critical_path.first_phase: Build the evidence-backed capability matrix from current parent contracts and live runtime/evidence. Do not reopen already-qualified foundations.
current_parent_critical_path.pass_condition: Every Book-owned expected capability has a current evidence-backed disposition, all stale Book obligations are reconciled without deleting history, and every remaining real gap has one explicit owner/objective/blocker/next-state rule.
current_parent_critical_path.pass_unlocks: Either a bounded new Book objective for the highest-value proven gap, or a Book parent machine-side completion boundary if and only if no Book-owned machine gap remains.

known_control_metadata_gap.rule: Census must reconcile this stale Book entry rather than allowing it to restart completed Version/Rollback work.

non_negotiables: Do not declare BOOK complete solely because the 48-case E2E synthetic composition gate passed.
Do not repeat or requalify already-closed exact-SHA foundations without a changed subject or proven recurrence.
Do not absorb PROSE child objectives into BOOK.
Do not treat Document System rendering/export mechanics as Book-owned implementation work.
Do not fabricate author, human, publication, distribution or production evidence.
Preserve failed subjects and superseded delegation history as evidence.
A stale governance pointer is reconciled; it never invalidates already-qualified work.
generic_continue_rule: Continue executes the Book-only completion census from the first incomplete evidence phase, checkpoints the matrix durably, reconciles stale Book obligations, and selects only a proven dependency-valid successor gap.
